glossary.title: Study Abroad & IB Glossary
glossary.ib_title: What is the IB Diploma Programme?
glossary.ib_summary: An internationally recognized, broad high-school curriculum. The diploma is scored out of 45; around 38 is often competitive, while 42+ can be a strong target for highly selective universities.
glossary.ib_detail: Students usually take six subjects, commonly three Higher Level (HL) and three Standard Level (SL), and complete TOK, EE, and CAS. TOK and EE can contribute up to three additional points.
glossary.hl_title: What is the difference between HL and SL?
glossary.hl_summary: HL (Higher Level) courses cover more material in greater depth; SL (Standard Level) courses are less intensive.
glossary.hl_detail: Some programs require specific subjects at HL and a minimum grade. IB usually permits up to four HL subjects, so balance entry requirements with workload.
glossary.math_title: How should I choose Math AA or Math AI?
glossary.math_summary: Math AA emphasizes algebra, functions, and calculus; Math AI emphasizes statistics, modeling, and practical applications.
glossary.math_detail: Math choices can affect eligibility. Some mathematics, computer science, and engineering programs may require or prefer Math AA HL. Check each university's current official requirements.
glossary.predicted_summary: A teacher's estimate of a student's final IB results, based on coursework and assessments.
glossary.predicted_detail: Universities may review applications before final IB exams, so predicted grades can influence conditional offers. They are not final results; requirements vary by country, institution, and program.

copy.符合条件的德国高校毕业生可了解毕业后求职居留；取得合资格工作后可能申请相应工作居: Eligible German university graduates may qualify for a post-study job-seeking residence permit. With a qualifying job, they may apply for a work residence permit or EU Blue Card and later seek long-term residence under applicable rules.
copy.求职居留、蓝卡薪资门槛和长期居留条件以申请时规则为准。: Check current rules for job-seeking residence, Blue Card salary thresholds, and long-term residence.

copy.需核对 IB 文凭和所选学科组合是否满足德国大学入学资格。: Check whether the IB Diploma and subject combination meet German university entry requirements.

copy.符合条件的毕业生可了解临时毕业生签证；技术移民可能涉及职业清单、技能评估、英语、: Eligible graduates may consider a Temporary Graduate visa. Skilled migration can involve occupation lists, skills assessments, English, age, and invitation criteria.
copy.签证类别、毕业资格和停留期限会随政策调整。: Visa categories, graduate eligibility, and permitted stays can change.
copy.技术移民通常采用积分或州/地区提名等规则，不保证获邀。: Skilled migration often uses points or state/territory nomination and does not guarantee an invitation.
copy.在选课阶段可留意目标职业的课程认证和技能评估要求。: When choosing courses, review accreditation and skills-assessment requirements for target occupations.
copy.用简明信息了解课程和常见毕业后路径；具体政策请以官方最新说明为准。: Explore IB courses and common post-study pathways. Always verify current policies with official sources.

copy.IB Diploma Programme 通常由 6 门学科组成，每科最高 7: The IB Diploma Programme usually includes six subjects worth up to seven points each, for a maximum of 42 subject points. TOK and EE can contribute up to three core points. CAS does not count toward the 45 points but is a required core component.
copy.毕业工签和永居资格受个人条件及政策调整影响。以下为常见路径概览，不构成法律或移民: Post-study work and permanent-residence eligibility depend on individual circumstances and changing rules. This overview is not legal or immigration advice; consult official government sources before applying.
copy.比较国家时，也要评估专业就业需求、语言要求、实习资源、生活成本和个人适应度，避免: When comparing destinations, consider job demand, language requirements, internships, living costs, and personal fit—not just the duration of a visa.
